# Release notes

The parser now handles nested emphasis, `inline code`, and
links (https://example.com/docs) in one pass. A loud word
and a snake_case_name pass through.

## Steps

1. Install the gem
   • run `bundle install`
   • check the lockfile
2. Configure it:

   ruby
   │ Rig.configure do |config|
   │   config.model = "anthropic/claude-sonnet"
   │ end
3. Ship

┃ Quoted advice that is long enough to wrap onto a second
┃ line when narrow.
┃
┃ • a quoted bullet

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

│ no language here

Flag         │ Meaning
─────────────┼───────────
`-p`         │ print once
`--no-color` │ plain

<b>HTML</b> stays literal, and see the local guide
(docs/HOSTS.md).
